worldcombat.skill.geargrind.summary: Hurl one spinning steel gear from each side; the pair crosses in and closes on the foe. Gears ricochet off whatever they hit, and a spent gear keeps spinning where it lands before breaking into shards. Cross style catches lateral dodges; straight style is faster and truer.
worldcombat.skill.geargrind.use.0: Throw two spinning steel gears from opposite sides
worldcombat.skill.geargrind.use.1: Use ricocheting gears to reach around cover
worldcombat.skill.geargrind.use.2: Pin down a foe that keeps stepping sideways
Hurl two steel gears in turn; each deals one hit on contact: the first for about %1$s (Attack-driven), the second for about %2$s (Speed-driven). Throw reach %3$s blocks, gear speed %4$s blocks per tick.
Throw deviation %1$s degrees, homing turn %2$s deg/tick, side offset %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.geargrind.cross.on: Cross style now: the gears swing out to both sides and home back together, so a sideways dodge is caught by the other gear; each is lighter, slightly slower and the gap is longer.
worldcombat.skill.geargrind.cross.off: Straight style now: both gears fly flat and fast along one line with no homing, each heavier, truer and quicker, but stepping to one side avoids them together.
worldcombat.skill.geargrind.timing: Range %1$s blocks, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.geargrind.growth.0: From level %1$s the first gear rises to %2$s and the second to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.geargrind.growth.1: From level %1$s the first gear is %2$s, the second %3$s and homing turn %4$s deg/tick.
worldcombat.skill.geargrind.preference.c: On: the gears swing out to both sides and home back together, so a sideways dodge is caught by the other gear; each is x0.95, slightly slower with +2 tick gap. Off (straight): both fly flat and fast along one line with no homing, x1.1 each, truer and quicker, but stepping to one side avoids them together.
worldcombat.skill.geargrind.preference.a: Beyond this distance it will not throw gears and closes in first.
The gears are real flying projectiles that ricochet off blocks, with a %1$s-block hit radius; the second gear is thrown %2$s after the first.
